header: How Meridian handles your portal data
intro: This notice covers meridiangroup.at, the customer portal and the Meridian Service app. It is written for buyers, design engineers and applicants, and names the systems where your data is stored.

sections.title: What we store when you request a quote
sections.content: Company name, contact name, work email, phone number and any drawing you upload. The drawing stays in the quotation system in Graz. We delete it 24 months after the quotation expires, unless it becomes an order.

sections.title: Who inside Meridian can see it
sections.content: The sales engineers of the division you contacted, the calculation desk and, once an order exists, quality staff. Brno and Turin see an enquiry only if the part will be made there. Nobody outside the group gets access.

sections.title: How to object, correct or delete
sections.content: Write to the data protection officer in Graz. We make corrections within five working days and deletions within 30 days. The exception is records that Austrian commercial law requires us to keep for seven years.
